label: Lower Pedal
cue: Keep a slight bend at the bottom.

label: Posture
cue: Sit tall; keep hips supported and level.

label: Opposed Legs
cue: Let the other leg take its turn.

label: Relaxed Grip
cue: Keep your grip relaxed and shoulders down.

label: Cadence
cue: Pedal steadily without yanking on the upstroke.

label: Resistance
cue: Adjust resistance to match your target effort.
